terms.comment: A trade name, kept as it is, as Latin speakers keep it: no reference work has a Latin word for it, and a translation of the name would not be recognised. Per Bluetooth cōnectere, to connect by Bluetooth, with Traupman’s cōnectere (p. 260).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 260: cōnectō.
No source has a word for Bluetooth.
